title: One thing tended, another neglected
odia: ଆମ୍ୱ ଗଛରେ ପାଣି ଦଉଁ ଦଉଁ ଶିମ୍ୱ ଗଛ ମଲା
literal_meaning: While watering the mango tree, the bean plant died.
explanation: Attention given to one concern can leave another unattended. This is an editorial reading of the contrast, not gardening advice.
meaning_odia: ଗୋଟିଏ କାମରେ ଲାଗି ଅନ୍ୟ କାମକୁ ଅବହେଳା କରିବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଏଥିରେ ଦିଶେ।
usage_example: Preparing a presentation, someone forgets a smaller urgent task. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary supplies the withering sense; no origin story.
